scripts.build:reader: cd reader && npm ci && export NODE_OPTIONS=--openssl-legacy-provider && PDFJS_CONFIG=web bash pdfjs/build && npx webpack --config-name web
scripts.build: rm -rf src-tauri/dist && cp -r reader/build/web src-tauri/dist && sed 's#</body>#<script type="module" src="main.js"></script></body>#' reader/build/web/reader.html > src-tauri/dist/index.html && esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=src-tauri/dist/main.js
